The research centre looks after them and takes their well-being extremely seriously. Pandas are funny, clumsy but very smart animals too. If you ever get an opportunity to visit, please do so. It’s a lifetime memory

Just okay. We already booked the ticket long time before came here. Turns out, when we came inside, we need to buy another ticket for the bus. But we cannot buy it since the register needs a local number. So we ended up walking all the way through. I went here with my family and some of them are elderly. So its quite tiring for them to walk.
All you need to know about giant panda & its origin. Great experience here. Nice walking path & view. You can spend one whole day exploring the vast area.

Founded in 1987, started with 6 giant pandas that were rescued from the wild. A good set up with good environment for the growth of pandas, it also good for visitors with convenience facilities. Worth to visit
Cuteness overload! My 2nd visit! Most of the interesting spots are near the South Gate. However, the West gate entrance was less crowded but be prepared to pay RMB30 for the buggy ride over.

This place is huge, it took us 6-7 hours to explore this on foot and also eventually on tram/shuttle train as we clocked 20000 steps. A lot of panda but definitely be there by 730am or earlier, the queue is always long, this is China!:

Outside from the hustle bustle of one of amazing capitals of provinces of China, located in Chengdu Sichuan, It's one thing you don't wanna miss while visiting the city. It amazing how the authorities has made a lab and a natural habitat next to each other. Even it's half man made but still it's amazing. Watching pandas doing their stuff is so funny. Book a full day for this visit if you wanna enjoy it in real. Subway goes their and then a free bus will take you to Museum/forest/zoo. It's vast area so take your time and water bottle with you. Try to schedule it on non cloudy day as pandas don't like cool or cold weather so they will be in just in their shelter instead of their habitats. I visited in 2017 or 2017, I'm sorry I forgot the ticket but I guess it was around 200rmb, but again I'm not sure about ticket price.

Basically the reason why you need to visit Chengdu, everything else is incidental. This park is highly accessible, has multiple walking routes and buses. Other than the giant panda it also keeps several specimens of the red panda. I went there two days during my trip. I should have gone more often. You can just watch them throughout the day eating bamboo, eating more bamboo and sleeping. Love the panda life. Hope they would have been in the wild as well.

My visit to the panda zoo was an incredible experience that I will cherish forever! The adorable black and white furballs were lazily munching on bamboo, their playful antics bringing smiles to the faces of the visitors 🥹🤍

The research center for For the giant panda bears It is Magnificent! If you get a Chung Du It is a must to see and you've truly missed A international gem! I took the picture of the bear with his mouth wide open... Don't worry he was just yawning, as the bear was just waking up. What an unusual and great experience!😊
An extremely well run and organized place to watch pandas in their practically natural habitat. Super easy to spot them there. Highly recommended.

We visit in the month of august and it’s so Hot coz it’s summer in china. Not recommended to come here in summer if u want to witness the panda coz they are sleeping and they are not outside. A little bit of disappointment but still happy coz i saw them personally. Next time to come here is winter, autumn and spring. But avoid summer coz panda need to be in cold area so they need to put them in the room if its hot outside.

A truly great location to visit China's famous Pandas. I managed to see plenty of adult and child giant pandas as well as red pandas. I went really early so it was a very comfortable trip. The venue is kept super clean and is a great place to walk around with all the greenery surrounding you.

It has a lot of Pandas and Red Pandas - what else do you have to know? ;) It's a really nice park and quite well to reach. You should go very early in the morning since it will be crowded during late morning hours and you get a chance at seeing young/baby pandas uo close when there aren't too many people. You can buy tickets online if you have the means or use the self service ticket machines on the right side of the entrance - they are in english too. Must see in Chengdu!

It's a must visit place when you are in Chengdu. We went to the wrong place to see the superstar "Hwa Hwa". Went to the Chengdu Zoo. And found no Hwa-Hwa. The staff of Chengdu said that Hwa-Hwa is on the Panda Breeding center. And we're quickly find a MTR then get a bus to get into the Panda Breeding center. It cost us ¥58 each person for the entrance ticket, and we got an hour queueing to see the Cute Hwa-Hwa. We had only 3 mins to see Hwa-Hwa. It worth to visit this place. Get a shuttle mini van to get around this place just for ¥30 each person. This place was a Huge place. And you may find many Pandas everywhere.

Kung Fu "naughty" Pandas Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding located around 10 kms from the city is one of the main attractions of Chengdu. The place is quite near to the city however there is no metro access and the bus route is quite complicated. It took us around half hour and RMB 50/- by the taxi to reach the research center. The park or research center spans 100 acres and is basically inside a forest with bamboo trees all around given the fact that Pandas only eat bamboos. We reached just in time to find ourselves making our way through the park easily with no rush and crowd. They were just adorable to watch as they started eating their breakfast without caring much about the big crowd gazing at them from a distance. Their lifestyle feels so carefree in just the way they eat some sitting down and some lying down and doesn’t care much else happening around them. You can just stand there and look at them all day Apart from Giant Panda they also include the Red Panda and some other endangered bird species. The park was really well maintained and was a treat to visit and can probably be the best spot to visit in Chengdu and can be labeled a must see in Chengdu.
A favourite tourist attraction to see the cute pandas. Advisable to prebook tickets online, come early in the morning to beat the queue and have a better touring experience.

A panda conservation facility which allow public viewing of various ages of pandas. Lots of tourists at least on the weekends. The park is well kept filled with greenery, pavements and bamboo trees. There are also scientific exhibition and musuem related to.conservation of pandas. Very educational place indeed. In addition, there are post office and souvenir shops. No restaurant on the facility though.

This vast area of a research base is packed full with visitors even in rainy weather. The best way to get in with few queuing hassles is with a tour. We had to wait for our rides in a small cart for about 30 minutes. The pandas are available for viewing outdoors, mostly. So many visitors will vie for spots to get pictures or videos. The indoor area can get smelly. We were rushed through the nursery, so you won't be satisfied looking at the panda cubs.

Highly recommend for getting to meet many lovely pandas! A must go place in chengdu. There are over 100 pandas! Among all also have other animals. But watch out for peak seasons when you need to queue for over 2 hrs to get in. You can purchase e tickets in advance via app.
Thoroughly enjoyed this. But get there early. The queues to get in the enclosure is carnage and the chinese love the camera!!!! I went in Sept and it was too hot for the Pandas so they were inside.
Lots of Pandas here. Come in early morning during summer to get sightings of them otherwise they will be in the tree’s shade where you can’t see them. It’s busy here with lots of people.

If you love Panda you can’t miss this place when you visited Chengdu We wanted to see huahua the most popular and of course cute panda but we missed her in the first visit because she was on day off every Monday thus we needed to revisit the panda base finally we were able to see huahua despite we needed to line up more than 30 minutes Huahua is indeed very cute … but all other panda in this place are also lovely too
Went to 2 zoos, did not get to see pandas. Visiting here today and I am fulfilled. Highly recommended for panda lovers.
Recommended to arrive at West gate before 8:30 am. Take the 30yuan shuttle service to get to the panda pavilion faster. So may baby pandas to see.

I arrived at 1pm on a Tuesday. The place was not as crowded as expected. *Tram Services* There is a tram service provided which cost 10RMB. Please note that it is a 2 way trip. The ride does not stop at every point. It just drops you to the panda enclosure and picks you up from there. You also wont get to see pandas along the tram ride unlike the Singapore Zoo/ Night Safari. * How long to stay* I stayed there for 2.5hs after takig the tram ride. The directions along the park were abit scarce so we actually made a big round and returned to the same location where the big pandas were. All the walking made us very tired so we didnt have much energy to explore the rest of the place. I would suggest putting my effort planning the trip and looking carefully at the signs for direction. * Summary * It is definitely worth a visit. This is the must visit place of Chengdu. You cant say you have been to Chengdu unless you have been here. It is really worth it because you get to see ALOT of pandas and all types of sizes (think of Kungfu panda 3 where it is a Panda Village). Be prepared to walk alot so bring comfy shoes. Souvenir shops and cafes are available for light shopping.
The place is huge and you need shuttle bus ticket to get around. Should spend 1 day in the park. Come in the morning to see panda avoid afternoon hours because they will likely sleep at that time.

If you love the idea of seeing pandas doing anything, set your expectations low because while they're adorable bundles of two-tone fur, much like the koala, they're not exactly action packed powerhouses! That said, they are indeed absurdly cute, and with the park being so well laid out, positively dripping with all the mod-cons anyone would need during an all-day visit, I highly recommend taking a day out of your busy holiday schedule to chill with the pandas.

Visiting Chengdu (China) without coming here would really be a shame! No matter what size and age; the "bear cats" (translation of Chinese Word for panda) is simple adorable! It's a long drive from Chengdu (2,5-3 h), but it is worth it! Make sure to be here early to beat the MANY visitors!! (The park is easily accessible, and has lots of benches and rest rooms.) Recommended!

Chinese people will queue for hours to see pandas, and that's exactly what you'd do, and not get the best shot. Apparently Chongqing's zoo is better and has way more pandas. I wish I knew that before coming here!!! Lol Anyway, now you know, don't make the same mistake I did 😅😂
First time seeing a live panda:such a beautiful animal.A very nice park to walk around

One panda , two panda , three ... May they continue mate , so we can enjoy the cute species for as long as it takes ! It is so admirable that people have come together to recreate the natural habitat , or as much of the natural habitat of this species as possible . We should consider Giant Pandass typically live in higher altitude and at much lower temperature levels , so maybe the lack of those conditions inbalances them pandas physiologically. It was fortunate to know that some atmosphere circumstances have changed the geo-positioning of their original habitat ... But maybe nothing is lost forever , there is always paradise to come .

Certainly the most important attraction in Chengdu. It's absolutely worth your time. The whole area is quite large and will likely take all of your morning or afternoon. If you arrive at the South Gate (which is further away from public transportation, so you will likely need Didi), all main giant panda enclosures will be near you. You can easily spend a couple hours gradually walking in north-west direction, hopefully spotting a few giant pandas while strolling in a beautiful bamboo forest. Closer to the center of the area you have panda nurseries as well as red panda enclosures. This is also where you will find restaurants/cafes/bathrooms. From there, you can continue either west towards the Bamboo tower - beautiful building, though not sure worth the climb if the elevator is not working - or north towards more panda nurseries and monkey areas. Eventually you will find yourself at the West Gate. This area is where the panda pavilions are, i.e. actual air-conditioned buildings with pandas inside them, as opposed to the open air panda villas near the South Gate which are much cooler to see. The pavilions were already closed in late October when I visited. This whole area is also the least shaded; if you entered from South Gate in the morning it's probably afternoon by now, and the relentless Chengdu sun will be burning you as you climb many stairs to the actual West Gate to leave the base. You can connect to the local bus No. 3 that will take you to the metro station.

No doubt the research center has done amazing work on creating solutions to save pandas from brink of extinction. Visitor centre is not well organized, lengthy walks from place to place, queues everywhere and facilities not well managed. Takes forever to visit to see few cute pandas..

Date: 04/04/2017 There were so many people but I was still able to observe the pandas closely. The experience was fun. Those pandas are just darn cute! If the weather were brighter it would be much better.

If you are in Chengdu don't miss this place, it is worth visiting. It is a combo of Panda zoo and research centre. Here you can see Pandas of every size, from new born to fully grown Giant Pandas. Unfortunately when I visited the Red Pandas area was closed for visitors, because most of them were pregnant and their safety was important.

such a fun place to see the pandas although make sure to come early because crowds get crazy by 10am and the pandas also go to sleep around midday!! the baby pandas in the moonlight area is the best they are so cute
Taking the shuttle bus is the best way to see the whole research base. Panda HuaHua only work 2 hours a day better check the time schedule be4 you go.

Totally worth it! Went 2 days since panda museum is closed on Mondays. The weather was perfect, so all of the pandas and red pandas were out and active. There are multiple places to eat, everything is walking friendly. There is a shuttle you have to pay to get around to the farther places. They have free lockers at the Info center at the South Gate. Online it says you must buy your tickets via WeChat. We had trouble getting them, but there is a ticket booth to buy tickets. Tickets are attached to your passport.
Love this panda zoo. Everything is cute and the scenery is beautiful. It’s tidy and cool. Be careful of mobile tiny train around the zoo. Oh I visited here on January, 2020.

If you are in Chengdu - Panda Park is a must for visit. It is a wonderful experience - the park is big enough and the animals live there like in the wild. In addition to the normal pandas, the less popular red pandas can also be seen there. Pandas are very adorable but really lazy - all they do is chew bamboo or sleep.

I want to visit here again! So many cute pandas! But also a lot of visitors.. I visited here twice during this trip, both in the morning and saw different activities. Some are very active playing and eating. It seems adult ones are more interested in sleeping. They got a twin new born baby panda now on display. Better to take the bus to the top of the hill and then head back if your time/fitness is limited.

Well established research center, it should be the best in the world as panda originated in Chengdu China. The star panda was called Hua Hua, smaller than it should be due to slow eating, not much exercise and lots of sleep. A beautiful settings and walking flow was well organised and supervised. Worth visiting and it is China's AAAAA place to visit.

A facility where great work is done to protect the pandas. Overall, the park has quite a number of enclosures but you will need a good zoom lens to get proper shots. Some stores beside the swan lake offer quick snacks for an affordable price.

If you love pandas 🐼, this is the best place on Earth. If you don't have a Chinese number, you can buy a ticket at the entrance using Alipay or cash. The park is enormous. So you can buy a ticket for the sightseeing bus inside the park. They only accept cash for the bus.

Take subway to Panda Ave. Station on line 3. By the ticket and take the free shuttle bus to the park, it takes about 5-10 minutes. The ticket is RMB $58, which is a little expensive. The stuff is very kindly and willing to help. If you can't find the pandas, tell the stuff around you and they'll tell you where the pandas are or they'll even take the bamboo to feed the pandas; you'll see the lovely panda in front of you!

It's one of places which you need to see when you are in Chengdu. It's good to be there during feeding time (between 9 and 11 in the morning). Pandas come out and don't hide behind trees ;) It takes about 2-5 hours to walk around.
Pandas are so adorable. You can see them closely and watch them eat bamboo all day. Recommend to buy a bus ticket once you enter the place.

Very very very nice place to see Panda ! I really appreciated this visite, even with the high and heavy temperature and humidity... We arrived very early the Friday, but at 9am, the park was already full of people ! Totally amazing ! Even that, Panda were so cute and we wanted to hug them :) It's a must see place if you are around Chengdu, take time to go there !
I’d been here in September.Because of heat,all pandas stayed indoor.I saw more than twenty pandas.They played in the morning,and keep coma at noon.So do not come here too late.

We enjoyed Giant and red pandas. They are so lovely and healthy. We saw around 31 of them. However, there are no baby pandas at the moment, only a few juveniles age, but it was worth it! Things to complain, in the internet said that we should take bus 198 and also the staff that work at the train station said the same but three of 198 buses refused us to go up. It took us over 1 hour to found out that it is bus 87 or 655. We also booked the entry ticket one day before for 88 yuan each but when we arrive the ticket only for 55 yuan. I'm confused why buy online is more expensive and in Alipay said need to book 1 day before. Also the shuttle bus is 30 yuan each, you need it to get around the park, it was huge!!! Even we travel around with shuttle bus, it took us over 7 hs around and not even see everything. There are also panda musical which they show at 14.00 and 9.90 yuan each. Travel in China had been so difficult for us, who don't speak Chinese. Map here is not good!! Google maps can't use and if can use, it is not accurate. I had been travel more than 55 countries and this is 3rd time visit China, I'm sure struggling with it.

Definitely a must visit if you are visiting CheungDu. Make sure to go when they open. Pandas need optimal temperature (23 degrees) when roaming outdoors. If the temperature gets too high, the Pandas get moved indoors. So best to visit first thing in the morning if you want to see them outdoors. The property is very large, wear comfortable shoes if you plan to walk around all the areas. Have fun!
Amazing panda nursery centers.. Such a huge area to explore. Enjoyed watching these cute animals, especially the little red panda, never know they existing.... It was unfortunately too crowded.

Nice place to see panda's life. Such a big place, need to spare 4-5 hours if you want to explore most area by foot. It was a bit difficult to order tickets for foreigner. If you purchase tickets through their official wechat, you will need Mainland phone number (and prepare translation app to translate). Suggest to order from third apl such as klook.

Terrific experience at the Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding which is a public non-profit breeding and research institute for giant pandas, red pandas, and other rare animals. The highlight of the trip was to see the lovely baby pandas, observing how they live and are taken care of.

Recommend to buy tickets in advance online. They don’t check your ID actually, so don’t worry about it. The base is huge, should be a full day trip. It has stroller rental which is quite family friendly. It has a great number of visitors, so expect to wait for some programs. It has cafe, restaurant, and everything you need, so just come with full energy and enjoy this experience. We had a great time even though we didn’t stay long here as we got tired quickly 🤣

I recommend to book the tickets in advance. As foreigner you will need your passport to register for each ticket. If you cannot use the official wechat miniprogram, please ask your friends to help you to buy them. This is the address of the downtown Research base of the Giant Panda breeding. 成都大熊猫繁育研究基地. We took a taxi to the South gate and then walked around 10 min to the entrance. Please do not forget to bring your passports otherwise you might not be able to use your purchased ticket. You can either choose visit from 8.00 until 12.00 or from 12.00 to 16.00.The park is really nice green and you can observe pandas from numerous stops. Though on our day we were not that lucky to see the pandas from close distance, we enjoyed the walk in the bamboo forrests.
Pandas are adorable. You can see them up close through partition glass. Very nice experience.

Giant Panda base. Very cute and fantastic posture of this peaceful creatures. I didn't know that Panda likes to sleep on a tree until I see them hanging their huge bodies at a tree's branches. Curious how long does it take to climb up to those branches.

Check their operational hours. Gets crowded over the weekend so plan to visit on a weekday. A lot of long walking required so check on accesibility before visit if you are traveling with person with limited mobility. Otherwise, a very Interesting experience! Seeing so many pandas in one place is amazing. If you’re in Chengdu, this is absolutely a must-do. Take the full route and stop at every spot to see the different types of pandas. A fantastic place to learn about conservation as well.
Must do in Chengdu. Very nice place to walk around and see many Panda. Need book in advance and bring your passport to enter. A tour guide is recommended. Don’t forget to see also red Panda.

Coming from a singaporean: Huge huge park, but panda were asleep during mid day (so pls go earlier in the morning) If you’re looking for panda (there’s many option available too, or check out the one in Singapore (cheaper and shorter option) Not a great place to bring elderly parents to (walked 8km for entire trip) with no tram/transport available (stop selling by mid day because it’s too popular). It is free entry for elderly above 60 years old. There are food available but it is only after hiking about 6-7km (slopes and stairs) from entrance to pedestrian street. Oh there’s McDonald there too. There’s audio guide for rental at 40 rmb each but didn’t use much to find it worthwhile getting. Would not recommend.

Very well designed place. Everything is in place. Restaurants, gift shops, cinema, museum. Large place needs a whole day to make enjoyable visit. Place dedicated for everyone perfect place for family day.

The weather was a bit on the warm side thus the pandas were not outside loitering, seemed like they were afraid of the heat too. We were able to have a glimpse of the pandas eating in the sanctuary, cute!
The pandas were so cute but the walk is a little difficult as there are lots of hills.

Don’t buy tickets on Klook. They’ll give you afternoon when you want morning and won’t let you cancel - if you have a ticket for the afternoon you can’t go in the morning. Great service from Klook and the staff! A huge waste of my time and money on holiday.

You need to buy ticket in advance. Booking via Chinese website also required local phone number. Separate line for non local. Waited 1,5hrs to visit He Hua(Hua Hua) celebrity panda at Villa No 6. Apart from Hua Hua, there are many other cute panda too. Please come as early as possible, panda are the cutest when they wake up and having breakfast. Take note they go nap after breakfast so you may not see them later.
Just bought tickets from trip.com key in your passport properly then just use your passport for entry

It needs more pandas and other activities. I came 30 years ago and it was very small but had a feeling of home for the pandas. It is industrialised now, loads of shops and food stalls. It would be a great family day out though. I just expected different.
Clean and carefully maintained space, it was a pleasure to see the pandas for the first time and learn about their history. I was pleasantly surprised to find that there are also red pandas.

The best way to spend your day! We came there at 7:30 by taxi (40 rmb from the center of chengdu) and were almost alone with the pandas. The park is huge so it takes time to find them at first, but it's also beautiful and peaceful to walk around it and have a rest. Also, in the morning they are still in small rooms and not outside which makes it easier to see them. We realized it only later in the day but lots of the pandas are in the moonlight delivery house area, and they're still sub-adults so they're more active then the sleepy adult pandas.

The visit to Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding was an incredible experience. The respect shown to the animals here by both the guests and staff was beautiful to see. Very clean park and misbehaving guests were corrected by the guards to secure the welfare of the animals. The pandas got new bamboo regularly from the staff and they cleaned their areas multiple times during the day. This experience was one of the highlights of my visit in Chengdu. I hope they continue showing this level of respect for the animals to maintain this incredible experience.

It's the best ever place to see the panda in your dreams! Very close to the Chengdu city center. Easy to reach. By name itself, is the "Panda base". So expect a huge crowd during holidays. Better if you can go in the morning when pandas are more active. 8 hours are enough for the whole visit according to my experience.
Can see alot of cute giant panda and red panda. The research centre is based on their natural habitat. The land area is super huge, would recommend buy the buggy ticket also.

Enjoyed visit A huge park We must have english speaking and understanding staff It's very very difficult to get any information. No guidance about the park. How to navigate.etc Not much announcement. No sign boards explain in english. Red panda looks V very small Staff not helpful as they don't understand english

Great place to visit in Chengdu. The park is well maintained, clean and organized. I suggest visiting in the morning (arrive at 8:30) and paying the extra ≈5¥ for the transport buses inside the park. They take you to the furthest corner and save you a 30 minute walk. The main downside is, that it is often very crowded. Definitely worth the fee of 58¥.
I truly fell in love with this Research Center. It is huge, but the bears are so cute. :-) Make sure that you bring your running shoes!!

A must see tourist spot if your going to china. I advise going early as it’s not as hot so you have the opportunity to see the pandas outside . When it gets too hot they bring them inside and they tend to just sleep. I recommend you walking the whole park as you will miss a lot of little things if you get the bus.

Our experience here was amazing! We received an English-speaking tour through trip.com. She explained so much about the pandas. On the day we went it was nice and cool and we got to see more pandas than we expected. The musical was a fun experience and they did a great job singing! The grounds were huge and so scenic. My only recommendation would be to have maps readily available as we often got lost on the grounds and weren't sure which way to go. But we had fun exploring anyway.
Amazing experience. Never saw pandas before and here there is a lot of them in nice environment. I would advise you to come early to see pandas more active as they are sleeping a lot through the day.
Totaly worth it. Went there with low expectations but totally loved the experience. The pandas are very nice and the reservation is well kept.
A must visit when visiting Chengdu, but do go early in the morning when it opens otherwise most of the pandas will be sleeping by midday.
No doubt about it, it is great. But it is still a little zoolike. But don't let that put you off. Easy to get to (didi) and easy to get back (walked to metro)

Travel from Chengdu East Station, very convenient. Arrive at noon, most pandas are asleep. But still pleasent to see they scratching themselves while sleeping. Very cute. According to some local guide, Pandas are more active from 7 to 9 am.
Came around 9.30 am, and the crowd is already in. Highly recommend to follow the guide as it is very informative. The panda starts to nap from 10 am, so may not be able to see them in action.

Loved it. Red pandas were fantastic as well as the giant pandas. Absolutely worth the visit. Most hotels have free one way shuttles so check before catching a cab, although cabs are not expensive. Support the economy :)
Pandas, Pandas and Pandas, must visit place. Wander and explore each area one by one.
Awesome place to watch lots of panda. Very nice and clean facilities. Recommend to take the buggy. It's best to start from the South gate.

Nice place, super cute panda bears! It's a research facility and zoo at the same time. Easy to reach with public transportation and you can buy the tickets already at the metro station (cheaper and less people Q-ing). We went early morning and had lots of active panda bears. The only downside were loud school groups or other loud tourists who ignored the "be quiet" signs totally - the zoo security didn't care much either. A bit sad as the pandas can't find a quiet area with so many loud visitors every single day...
A great place, open air and of course the Pandas are cute....best thing if you're 60 and over get in for free!! The lake is beautiful and the butterfly collection are awesome.
Chengdu Research Base is about 20mins drive from Chengdu city center. The place has many giant pandas and red pandas.

Very well planned. Expect that you will spend at least couple of hours to seek out for Pandas, foxes and other special species to the area. There are lots of tourists indeed but at certain areas, it can be beautifully quaint.

Only one tip. Come early, like at 7:00AM to line up and go in to begin seeing the pandas. Later than that and all you'll be seeing is people. That being said, I saw pandas. Being really cute and stuff. It was great.

Not recommended at all. Poorly designed place, A LOT OF WALKING just to reach one panda and no proper signage so it's very easy to get lost here. Staffs are rude as well and not helpful to English speakers. Glasses here are reflective so you can't see the pandas clearly. Overall, not recommended. Poorly designed and poorly managed place.

We followed some advices online and entered through the west gate in the early morning. This was honestly a mistake. It was empty, yes, but super far from everything. They had no easy walking access as there were hundreds of stairs to climb just to get to the path. Shuttle is the only good option so this will basically double your entrance fee if you choose to go to this gate. All the big popular panda enclosures are down by the south gate. We wasted an hour just getting to the real attractions and by then it was already super crowded even on a weekday. The nurseries were totally empty, no pandas to be seen. No idea why, there wasn’t any signage and we wasted our time walking to these nurseries. Also, shuttles and map are super confusing if you’re a foreigner. No one speaks English. Even though I’m a huge proponent of independent travel, I went as part of a small tour group my first visit to the Panda Base years ago and after doing it by ourselves recently, I fear I’d have to recommend the tour group instead as they know exactly where to go at which time for the best viewing experiences.
This is a must see in any trip to Chengdu highly recommend it. The Pandas are just great. Make sure to show up at opening because it's when the Pandas are fed and they are more lively.

Make sure that you show up early because last time chance to see the pandas at 11:00 am after that usually is cold (during winter) and the pandas wants to go inside, make sure that you don't have flash in your cameras, they don't like it. If you try to save some money buy the souvenir outside, and make sure that you wear something related to panda. Example a medium panda toy outside 15 yens inside 70 same panda Panda ears for girls outside 10 yens inside 25 Chengdu is a city with lot of small stores selling 🐼 things, keychains, clothes, magnents, super cheap, kuan alley is a good option to buy and don't forget to bargain

Awesome place don't go if you think you'll see it all in a couple of hours, you won't. The place is huge with roads and trails in all directions. Tip, best time to see the pandas is in the morning they usually are asleep in the afternoon.

Tickets: you can only buy them online with a WeChat app. There is no sale at the entrance. App is only in Mandarin, we got help from the staff at our hotel. Within the entrance lane there is an information table with some English speaking supporters. Getting there: Take metro 3 to Panda Avenue. There seem busses from there, but a DiDi costs less than 20 Yuan. Eating: the Bamboo restaurant on the campus was delicious and reasonably priced. Fair number of vegetarian options.

While I'm giving this place a relatively low score I also do believe it is one place that you really should visit if you happen to be in Chengdu and want to see real pandas. However, the place is enormous and the amount of pandas to see are very few in comparison. You'll be doing a lot of walking and not that much watching.

It was worth every penny. The research centre is huge so be prepared to do a lot of walking and it's definitely best to go early in the morning. I was impressed by their conservation efforts. I learned a lot and I enjoyed the adorable antics of the young pandas and red pandas.

not too crowd besides visiting panda star, Hua Hua. the area is large, better wear sports shoes. Pandas are far away from the visitors, the environment is a bit messy comparing with the Panda Hill 1hr away from the Chengdu center.

It's a great place to see panda of China. Better to go on weekdays as it is very crowded on weekend. The gact that it is located not too far fron the city is a plus for me. Definetely worth a visit when you're in Chengdu China

Not recommended on a hot day. All the pandas are indoors when the weather is hot. Park is massive and can take over an hour to walk from one end to another. Shuttles between the panda enclosures have very long lines of 45+ minutes - with most of the waiting area unshaded in the hot sun. Feels like a poorly managed Panda Disneyland - would recommend one of the more natural panda reserves further away from the city center.
Great experience. Would advice to come there as early as possible (maybe even on a national holiday). As a tourist you can buy the ticket on the spot (bringing a passport for this is mandatory)

Very interesting and well made. Nice paths around the various Panda enclosures. Plenty of restrooms so you can take your time. Sometimes hard to snap some good pictures due to the amount of people. Get the early!
Amazing place! ❤️ 🐼🐼🐼 soooo cute and lazy, and overall all this park very nice to visit, fresh air, lot of green, nice place to spend all day just walking around 😍😍
A Very Big Place with different species of Panda, the place is well maintained and clean. It can be very crowded during the weekends as it is very family friendly.
Very unique experience to see this many pandas at one location! The park and the animals are clearly well taken care of.

I came here with my friends, and the giant pandas are so cute. besides we saw red pandas the are cute too. Here are some tips for you : → 1. choose a COOL day. pandas dont like hot weather,they will stay at the panda room when its too hot and you wont see any panda.If you go there in summer ,earlier is better.the zoo opening time is 8:00 am. → 2. AVOID WEEKEND AND CHINESE FESTIVAL! you must remenber this. me and my friends visited On August 10 which is a weekend day.So we met thousands of people.we were pushed by the wave of people all the way. → 3. IF YOURE HAVING TROUBLE. just ask young people for help.Chinese are friendly and well educated .....and a lit bit of shy.if theyre able to help,they will help you. Leave your g map aside and use local map app, because g map's location is wrong in china. Have a good day!
Just wonderful to see so many Giant Pandas. They are in large enclosures with plenty of bamboo to eat. There is also a successful breeding program.

Too many people. Too few Pandas. So when one Panda appears there was crowd and hard for children to see the Pandas. Come early before gate open on 7.30am and avoid weekend or holiday. We only spent 2 hours there because of the overcrowding.
Best place to see pandas in their natural habitat! Busy duting tourist season, but worth a visit. Well managed and clean environment. Cool getaway from the humid city in summers.
Pandas were so cute! Recommend going in the morning when they are mist active and before they sleep / go back inside : )

A must see in Chengdu! Try to be at the center by 7 to beat the crowd for the ticketing (you can order online a bit more expensive) and queueing. Also, pandas usually ear early in the morning when it is coller, and sleep the rest of the day. So if you want to see some actions, be there early! Skip the bus line and follow the many many tour guides on the ground. Get your camera ready for some cute photography. The park will take min 2 hours to cover. For return, don't get the taxi as they are charging double or triple prices. Instead get a shuttle bus to one of the Chengdu historic district by 10 Yen.

Arrived at 8am, still managed to see pandas from baby to adult out and about. But by the time I left at about noon they were asleep. Be prepared to walk a lot as the area is huge. Don't miss No.1 house of pandas!

The best place to check out pandas are at the Panda breeding centre in the town of Chengdu in China. Not only can you get to see them really close up but you can also see how they are trying to increase the ability for the pandas to survive in nature. You also see other species such as the much smaller red panda. Given the location of the base you will walk through the forest and enjoy nature in an otherwise busy town. Don't miss the new born and baby panda section.

I visited the panda base in Jan 2019. You will not be disappointed because you will a lot of Giant pandas here. However maybe I did not go at the right time, they are very sleepy and not active. They have other animals as well such as a black swan. They have a restaurant in the base and I remember that is good.

This, of course, is a must visit in Chengdu. The pandas are just incredibly fun to watch, big, cub and babies! The whole area actually has lots of greens, including many bamboo trees, great place to walk around and spend a whole day!

Panda research center. Lots of pandas of various ages. There is a walking tour through the entire center and a nice cafeteria. Very good food. Wear good hiking shoes, steep walking in spots. Shuttles available for those who have trouble walking. Many different venues to see pandas in their natural habitats, also too see the nursery, and the educational center. Oh! And don't forget the gift shop! TONS of souvenirs...all Pandas - all the time!!!
Eventhough this place sooo huge, but you will be happy because those Pandas will amuse you! 🐼 Do come early because after 9 am or so, they will just sleep, whole day! 😆

It’s a great park, well maintained, you can either walk or take the sightseeing bus (remember to book in advance!). There’s a separate queue for passport holders, which make it easier for those who want to go early for Hua Hua. However, getting in early doesn’t guarantee you will see Hua Hua, it’s all about timing. It seems like Hua Hua usually eats around 9:30 and you only have 3 minutes in the area that has best sight of Hua Hua.

From the beginning, the pandas were super very charming, however, when it comes to the atmosphere, the tragedy is very not tourist-friendly, few signs in English, few maps of the whole park, the staff do not speak any language except Chinese, they were also not very helpful Wirecz, hostile and not pleasant There at 7:00 (they open at 7:30 am) the queue was already then, we had a passport entrance separate from the main queue, which took a long time anyway because the employees there are not equipped with scanners, they only manually write down the data From the passport which they also do not respect me, it was pushed into my hands (it is good that I have a rigid protective packaging if I did not have it, it would be damaged), the place itself is really nice, it is relatively clean, it is quite nice and really pleasant views, it is also worth adding that to buy a ticket to Melexes that will bind you from one part of the park on the road, you should have a Chinese phone number, of course, it is nowhere to be found, it is not indicated anywhere, you can pay in cash, which is also not marked anywhere, but the biggest drawback is people are very tight and visitors from China Pushing squeezes arguing about everything that all employees of "protection" Geberals of the Park employees despite the signs to keep the silence, uses a megaphone right next to the Panda catwalk. For panda lovers, however, I recommend it for people who value space I recommend that you stay away from personal and order and order
The best place for family and friends to see pandas ....it's very big and many pandas are there
Nice park with so many pandas 🐼, even with red pandas 🐻 If you go there, better go very early to be able to see more pandas and avoid the crowd.
A MUST VISIT. Pandas are so cute..😄😄 Open at 7.30am. Make sure u come early to avoid the crowd
It's a very nice place for family! It's better to arrive as early as you can during summer time, the pandas will go back to inside when the temperature is high.

Seeing the Gaint Pandas was one of the highlights of this tour. It is not a zoo they are trying to build up the population of Giant Pandas, they also have Red Pandas. It is a very interesting place and the Pandas are treated as royalty.
You can enjoy the panda vibe from the beginning to the end. There are many pandas and they are not in cages or whatsoever. There are cool activities to do while in the base.

They are so cute! Incredible experience! The place is looked after very well and it is nice to see how good they take care of those sweet creatures. It is so cute to see them playing, eating bamboo or sleeping in the trees!!
you can spend all day here, watching the life of a panda. its very nice to see them in the real eyes.
It was a cool experience, got to see a few different species of pandas. Alot of nice walking tracks and the great Panda museum was very informative.
Amazing pandas! Best way get there install Didi taxi on your mobile, can pay by Visa/MasterCard, cheaper then city taxi

It's hilly so wear your best walking shoes. Maps are provided at the front gate. We enjoyed being able to view red pandas, as well as giant pandas. Our family regrets not holding a baby giant panda. If you can afford it, it's recommended. Be sure to visit the gift shop.

It was great to see the pandas, but I had to take off a point for the intense crowds and all of the maps with a "you are here" dot rubbed off, so it was really easy to get lost. We didn't get any maps when we bought our tickets but I had printed one out at home before we came which helped a little

very good place. everywhere you will find panda. here you can see a variety of pandas in their natural habitat. the surroundings are very clean which attracted me a lot. you must visit one time here if you are panda lover. child friendly. eco friendly place. best place for nature lover and wildlife photographers. love the place a lot.

Amazing place- This place is huge - do take a translator if you cannot speak Chinese, you can find one inside the park as well. There are buggies that allow u transfer from one place to the other as this place is too big.
So. Nice so big place you can see different panda a lot of them a lot of different panda Definitely enjoyed it
Be prepare to walk bc is a huge place, worth the visit. And go early is super crowded.

This is a really impressive set up covering a large area. The grounds are extensive and beautifully laid out. The panda enclosures are large but if you're patient you'll have opportunities to see the pandas. There are also a few other animals here. There will be a bit of walking required but there are a number of rest areas and food/drink stops.
I went to this place on last Sunday, not that crowded. Most importantly to take photos of the pandas.
Really cool place but a lot of the attractions were closed which there was no warning of before entering the park
Very nice and purpose build venue. Highly recommended you book ahead, if you bringing kids mayne good idea to book a hotel nearby as this place gets extremely crowded at 7am.
Very good place to see a lot of giant panda in this large area park near by Chengdu city China.

Great place to see giant panda and red panda. famous in chengdu city, so if you are there, it is a must see. it's a bit of a tourist destination, but certainly worth going if you are there. lots of pandas and great views.
It was an amazing experience, loved it! The pandas, the place, everything in this place was fun! Totally recommend!

Before going, I read 2 hours would be enough to see the entire park. LOL... You can easily spend 6 or 8 hours there. It's a very vast and beautifully maintained area. The only disappointment was that basically all pandas were indoors, even though it was a relatively cool day. So you could only take photos of them through more or less dirty windows. I'm sure they do prefer the air-conditioned interiors, but with them being native to the region, I personally think they would have been able to deal with outdoor weather. After all, pandas in nature don't usually retreat into air-conditioned rooms when they feel it's too hot ;)

Pandas not actively staying outside during summer due to hot weather. Long queue just for the few minutes viewing time. Tour guide suggested November to April might be a better season to view pandas as the weather is cooler. Pandas are super cute though.

Information is a bit poor, all Pandas were kept inside and enclosed houses closed with no information. We were probably walking up and down for 3-4 km at 30 degrees without the possibility to see anything. I understand Pandas need rest but the whole point of coming here is to see them, so if no Pandas a save my time and legs for another thing. Disappointed
Love the environment here. We got to see pandas for the 1st time and it's great to see they got taken cared of very well.

This place is massive, so be prepared for lots of walking. To make your visit more comfortable, highly recommend booking the shuttle service. Additionally, don't forget to bring mosquito repellent to protect yourself from those pesky bugs.
Very cute and lively giant panda here, especially those baby panda! The whole garden is beautiful!

This place is kind of a must do in Chengdu. The panda is a mascot of the region and when you see the cute little guys you can see why. I got some good photos even though there were crowds and I was a bit late. So I definitely recommend it.
It's a zoo. So many people, so much pushing. Does not feel like a research base.

I was here for hours only saw one panda. There are tons of exhibits and pavilions that end up being closed or empty once you spend energy and time going there. There's no clear discernment of where they actually are, what's actually open and what's actually closed. It's very large and the shuttle stops aren't clear where they are stopping or what you might be able to reach. Otherwise you would spend hours walking. Complete waste of time.
Bucket list! Seeing where research and breeding pandas happens was high on the list. Crowded, a lot of walking, worth every hardship.
Fantastic opportunity to see pandas both indoors and outdoors. Thoroughly recommended for anyone who visits Chengdu.
Must visit if you're visiting ChengDu. Highly recommended to go in the morning to avoid the crowd and catch the pandas before they get off work in the afternoon.
Amazing for see the giant pandas from babies to adults. Better going early morning to see them more active taking their breakfast.
Visited today for RM55 per person. Completed by foot within 2 hours. Nice place to spent a day.
Even though after awhile all the pandas/red pandas looked the same, but saw hua hua so it was worth it
So much Pandas! A huge place full of black&white. If you have a small place to giant pandas in hearth, I recommend you to pay a visit here ♥️🐼

Big area covered with trees and shades. You can see Pandas under the shades if it is not high temperature outside. Giant pandas use to stay inside their cooled cabins and play with big ice cubes if its hot outside.
As a native, this is my first time to walk into the base, but it's still so exited to watch pandas though natives watch pandas in the zoo of Chengdu city when child

It is an interesting place to visit if you enjoy watching Giant Pandas. Unfortunately it is quite rare for us to see an active one. On the contrary the little Red Pandas are super active and super cute. My girls loved watching them.
If you come to Chengdu for a visit, this is a ‘must’ visit one. So good to see giant pandas. The facility is very well maintained.
